case_title.quote: N PARAMESWARAN UNNI v. G KANNAN AND ANOTHER

number_of_accused.reason: Only the first respondent is the accused.

accused_gender.quote: first respondent issued two cheques ... drawn on ... his bank
accused_gender.reason: The accused is referred to as 'he/his', so male.

accused_victim_relationship.quote: first respondent/accused borrowed Rs. 64,000/- on 13-10-1990 from the appellant/complainant
accused_victim_relationship.reason: Borrower–lender relationship is stated; 'acquaintance' label is only an inference.

statutory_provisions.quote: Section 138 r/w 142 of N.I. Act is attracted

evidence_type.quote: documentary evidence adduced on behalf of the parties
evidence_type.reason: Documentary evidence is consistent with the judgment.

trial_court_outcome.quote: convicted and sentenced the first respondent to undergo simple imprisonment of three months

high_court_outcome.quote: allowed the revision by reversing the concurrent findings

final_outcome.quote: we set aside the impugned judgment of the High Court
final_outcome.reason: HC set aside, conviction upheld, sentence modified to payment in lieu.

offence_finally_established.quote: Section 138 r/w 142 of N.I. Act is attracted

imprisonment_type.quote: in lieu of suffering simple imprisonment of three months
imprisonment_type.reason: Imprisonment replaced by deposit; revives only on default.

fine_rs.reason: No fine; Rs 2 lakh is deposit/compensation.

neutral_facts.quote: Appellant again sent the legal notice on 04-05-1991.
neutral_facts.reason: Facts match the judgment and do not reveal the outcome.

financial_property_loss.quote: first respondent failed to return the borrowed amount Rs. 64,000/-

motive.reason: No motive adjudicated; description is cautious.

key_evidence_accepted.quote: the first notice sent by appellant on 12-04-1991 was effective and notice was deemed to have been served

bail_history.quote: bail granted to the first respondent shall stand cancelled

legal_representation.quote: M. Gireesh Kumar, Sriram P., Ms. Athira G. Nair

investigation_status.quote: On 23.05.1991 appellant lodged a private complaint

appeal_history.quote: dismissed the appeal by upholding and confirming the judgment of the Trial Court

prosecution_argument.reason: Complainant's arguments are not recorded separately.

defence_argument.correct_value: Section 138 not attracted as notice demanding payment (04-05-1991) was beyond 15 days of bank's dishonour intimation (08-04-1991).
defence_argument.quote: The only ground raised before the High Court was that the provisions of Section 138 of the N.I. Act cannot be invoked
defence_argument.reason: The judgment records the respondent's ground of limitation.

legal_principle_applied.quote: once notice is sent by registered post by correctly addressing to the drawer of the cheque, the service of notice is deemed to have been effected

precedent_relied_upon.quote: Jagdish Singh v. Natthu Singh, ( 1992) I SCC 647; State of M.P. v. Hiralal

sentencing_rationale.correct_value: Payment of Rs 2,00,000 in lieu of imprisonment, based on respondent's counsel's undertaking, agreed by appellant.
sentencing_rationale.quote: first respondent was willing to pay Rs. 2,00,000/-(Rupees two lakhs only) in lieu of suffering simple imprisonment
sentencing_rationale.reason: The judgment gives the consent-based reason for the substituted sentence.

other_sentence_order.quote: Rs.1,30,000/-( one lakh thirty thousand) shall be paid to the appellant as compensation
